name: Placer.ai
positioning: Foot traffic as a leasing argument — how many people actually walk into this centre, and where else do they go.
description: Placer.ai turns anonymised mobile location data into visit metrics for physical venues: visit counts, dwell time, trade-area maps, visitor demographics and cross-shopping between brands. Coverage is strongest in the US, with an expanding international footprint.
real_estate_use: In retail leasing it replaces the argument from intuition. A landlord shows a prospective tenant that the centre draws a measured number of visits from a trade area matching the brand's customer profile. Investors use the same data to underwrite retail assets and to spot decline before it appears in the rent roll.
features: Visit counts and trends per venue and per chain
Trade-area maps and visitor origin analysis
Site selection scoring for new locations

use_cases.job: Underwrite a retail asset on measured footfall rather than on reported sales
Prove trade-area quality to a retail tenant during lease negotiation

capabilities: Visit estimation models from mobile location panels
